title: getrusage leaves maintained resource-accounting fields zero
mechanism: Every target arm of sys_getrusage builds rusage_t with only ru_utime and ru_stime and fills the rest with Default, so fields that Linux maintains, such as ru_maxrss, ru_minflt, ru_majflt, ru_nvcsw and ru_nivcsw, are always zero.
contract: getrusage(2): Linux maintains ru_utime, ru_stime, ru_maxrss, ru_minflt, ru_majflt, ru_inblock, ru_oublock, ru_nvcsw and ru_nivcsw, so after touching 8 MiB of anonymous memory ru_maxrss and ru_minflt are positive.
observed: By source reading at the pin (not run): getrusage returns zero for every field except ru_utime and ru_stime, for RUSAGE_SELF, RUSAGE_THREAD and RUSAGE_CHILDREN.

repro.how_to_run: Run `make static` in repro/ on x86-64 Linux, copy bin/abi_probe into an Asterinas guest, and run `abi_probe <case>` for rusage_accounting. repro/README.md gives the saved Linux output.

caveats: SOURCE LEAD, Asterinas NOT_RUN. Compare only fields Linux maintains. The probe asserts only ru_maxrss > 0 and ru_minflt > 0. Legacy text-only probe.
